    Pretorsion theories: first properties #

    Lemma 2.11: Z-prekernels are monomorphisms and Z-precokernels are epimorphisms. Proposition 2.3 (Campanini–Fedele–Yıldırım): the first component of a pretorsion theory is quotient-closed and the second is subobject-closed; closure under finite direct sums and summands is part of the subcategory convention here. Invariance of prekernels and precokernels under isomorphisms is recorded as well.

    CategoryTheory.Mono u
